en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.
New-product content research: Supported ZUS Coffee launch research by reviewing audience preferences, social feedback and competitor content to distil messages for social media.
Social content execution: Supported 50 Instagram posts, including topic planning, shooting, editing, English copy, hashtags and asset organization.

Channel coordination and review: Supported online launches and FamilyMart communication with assets, store information and publishing schedules. Tracked performance weekly and completed 15+ reviews, contributing to 11k+ account follower growth.

Education use-case research: Classified 100+ feedback items from local and overseas university users across teaching, lesson preparation and self-study, identifying recurring needs and content opportunities.

Content built from scratch: Supported the product WeChat account with 30+ guides, FAQs and use cases. Adjusted explanations and demonstrations around user difficulties; core-feature usage increased 30% during the period.
Overseas collaboration: Supported Southeast Asia AI education partnerships by clarifying needs and responsibilities and following up on agreements and project coordination.

University events and feedback: Coordinated demonstrations and trials with product and business teams, prepared materials and answered on-site questions. Consolidated user and teacher feedback into 10 improvement suggestions for product updates and future pilots.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

User insights and topics: Used feedback and pricing surveys to understand needs, payment concerns and content preferences by user stage, then translated recurring questions into product messages and topics. Designed selected acquisition activities and supported technology-event materials and on-site execution.
AI-assisted research: Used AI to classify user feedback and help build a lightweight operations dashboard; checked analytical outputs against original data.

Content and creator matching: Delivered 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts covering product introductions, tutorials and industry cases. Screened finance and AI creators by audience profile, content relevance and engagement, supporting content preparation and launch tracking.

Distribution tests and review: Tested titles, covers and content openings across social channels, communities and technology events, then adjusted budgets and content. Campaign registrations rose 50% versus the previous week; first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: Marketing postgraduate with working English and experience in AI products and overseas social media; applies feedback to content and delivery.
Content and media: user research, topic planning, scripts and copy, KOL/KOC screening, distribution tests and event execution.
AI: assisted research, content creation, data analysis and lightweight dashboard building; recurring work documented as SOPs.
Content: Xiaohongshu, Instagram, WeChat, Canva, CapCut and Figma (basic).
